title: Live: Trump says Iran wants to 'negotiate' as US threatens military action after hundreds killed
summary: US President Donald Trump said Sunday that Iran's leadership had called him seeking "to negotiate" after he repeatedly threatened to intervene militarily if Tehran killed protesters. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: US President Donald Trump said Sunday that Iran's leadership had called him seeking "to negotiate" after he repeatedly threatened to intervene militarily if Tehran killed protesters. While a Norway-based NGO has confirmed that at least 192 people have been killed so far, a US-based organisation has estimated it to be at least 544 people, including 48 security forces. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
